name: dumbbell standing cross clean
description: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and clean one across the body toward the opposite shoulder while the other stays at your side.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Hinge slightly, then drive through the hips as you shrug one dumbbell upward across your body.
Guide that dumbbell to the opposite shoulder while the other remains hanging at your side.
Lower it under control and alternate arms.
